title: Maritime Technologies: university hosts research conference
summary: Researchers discussed digitalisation of shipping, environmental safety and engineering education.

body.text: The international research conference “Maritime Technologies and Sustainable Transport” took place in Novorossiysk, bringing together universities, shipping companies and industry associations.

items: Digital twins of ships and ports.

body.text: Conference materials will be published in the proceedings and made available in the Research section.
